Edit the FIRST supplied image, which is an existing transparent 4-column by 2-row eight-view full-body fashion sprite atlas. The SECOND image is solely the new facial identity reference supplied by the user.

Replace the model's facial identity in every visible face with the adult woman in the SECOND portrait. Faithfully preserve that portrait's distinctive eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, soft cheek shape and jaw proportions. The same reference woman must be recognizable in the frontal and right-facing views. Do not keep the old model's face. Use natural realistic skin detail, calm neutral expression and clean natural makeup. Match the first image's soft neutral daylight on the new face.
Keep the FIRST image's exact clothing, shoes, relaxed body pose, body proportions, ponytail hairstyle, image grid, camera distance, character scale, baseline, and all eight camera angles unchanged. Do NOT copy the second portrait's historical dress, elaborate floral hair accessories, dangling jewelry, flower cheek decoration, or dim background. Only the facial identity is to change.
Preserve exactly eight separate full-body figures in the 4x2 atlas: front, right three-quarter, right profile, right three-quarter back, straight back, left three-quarter back, left profile, left three-quarter front. Identical figure scale and cell alignment. Keep the complete head and shoes in each cell. The atlas will be used for animation so alignment is critical.
Output ONE square PNG with genuine transparent alpha, with perfectly clean transparent gaps between figures. No white background, no checkerboard pattern, no text, no captions, no labels, no extra image or portrait inset. Photographic realism.
